subject: Azure Marketplace publisher account: manifest/ARM template remediation + private-offer path
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Campbell <sarah.campbell@contoso.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Azure Marketplace publisher account: manifest/ARM template remediation + private-offer path

Hi Sarah —

Thanks again for walking through the initial portal run with us this morning. We hit two blocking items in validation and I want to outline a short remediation plan so we can get the offer back into the sandbox today: 

Summary of issues we saw (from the portal validation):
- Offer manifest missing publisherId and has an extra top-level field "supportUrl" that the portal rejects.
- ARM template parameter schema mismatch: "siteName" expected string, the template currently uses an object for managedIdentity.

Proposed immediate steps (team owns):
1) Redwood: update offer-manifest.json to include publisherId and remove unsupported keys. (Karthik)
2) Redwood: patch ARM template to flatten managedIdentity params and add smoke deployment script (deploy-sample.sh). (Vivek)
3) Contoso: re-run the portal validation and share the validation log if anything else pops. (Sarah)
4) Olga: prepare the publisher identity evidence PDF (identity-evidence.pdf) and tenant proof for private-offer path.

Attachments: offer-manifest.json (draft), arm-template.zip (current), identity-evidence.pdf (placeholder).

If we can get the manifest + template PR in the next 3 hours we should be able to re-submit to the publisher portal and request a private-offer review. I suggested a 30-minute check-in at 1:00 PM PDT — please let me know if that works for you.

Best,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Head, Marketplace Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Sarah Campbell <sarah.campbell@contoso.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 10:26:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Azure Marketplace publisher account: manifest/ARM template remediation + private-offer path

Marissa —

Thanks for the clear plan. I re-ran the validation and attached the portal log (marketplace-validation-log.txt). The portal flags two specific errors: 

1) manifest.json: missing required key 'publisherId' under OfferSettings. Also the portal rejects supportUrl when not listed in allowed fields (we saw a schema mismatch in v2 of the manifest).

2) ARM deploy: TemplateValidationError at /resources/0/properties/siteName - expected type 'string' but found 'object'. The managedIdentity object is being passed directly from our infra pipeline.

I opened a quick PR in our infra repo that strips managedIdentity down to the principalId only (https://git.contoso.com/infra/azure-templates/pull/512), but we'll still need your patched ARM to align types.

Private-offer path: we'll want the identity-evidence.pdf and the signed marketplace MSA before Marketplace can approve a private offer. I can surface the DocuSign POA once legal signs.

I'll be available at 1:00 PM PDT for the check-in. Attaching the validation log.

- Sarah
Senior Partner Ops Manager
Contoso Corp

Attachment: marketplace-validation-log.txt

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>, Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Azure Marketplace publisher account: manifest/ARM template remediation + private-offer path

Team — forwarding Sarah's validation log. Short action items: 

- Karthik: can you update the offer-manifest.json to add publisherId and remove supportUrl? Keep the rest of the metadata identical to what Contoso provided. We should validate locally against the marketplace manifest schema (I can share the schema link).
- Vivek: patch the ARM in arm-template.zip to convert managedIdentity to a string parameter (siteName stays string). Add a small deploy-sample.sh that uses az group deployment create --template-file and checks 'outputs.deploymentStatus'.
- Olga: please start assembling the final identity-evidence.pdf with tenant claim screenshots, SPN creation audit, and the signed MSA stub when it arrives. Contoso needs this for private-offer approval.

Make the PRs against the branch "contoso-marketplace-fix" and ping Sarah when ready. Aim for the PRs within 3 hours.

Onwards,
Marissa

> On Apr 11, 2027, at 10:26 AM, Sarah Campbell <sarah.campbell@contoso.com> wrote:
> 
> > The portal flags two specific errors: manifest.json: missing required key 'publisherId' and ARM TemplateValidationError: expected 'string' found 'object'.
> > Attachment: marketplace-validation-log.txt

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>, Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 12:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Azure Marketplace publisher account: manifest/ARM template remediation + private-offer path

Marissa / team — quick technical notes from my side: 

1) Manifest: I'll inject publisherId (we have Redwood's publisherId for Contoso mapping) and run it through the manifest-lint tool. Also stripping unsupported keys (supportUrl) and adding the pricingPlanId placeholder for private offers.

2) ARM: Vivek and I paired on a minimal change: change the managedIdentity param to managedIdentityPrincipalId (string), update the resource to reference that string, and keep siteName as string. I will include a schema comment in the PR so Contoso's infra team can reconcile.

3) Smoke script: I'll add deploy-sample.sh that takes RESOURCE_GROUP and runs an ephemeral deployment with unique suffix. Output will include a small health-check endpoint hit (curl to /health).

Timing: I can push the manifest PR in ~40 minutes, ARM + script in 90 minutes. If Contoso's PR to strip managedIdentity lands before we push, we can shorten that.

Notes on private vs SaaS: If Contoso wants a private offer, we must ensure the plan definitions include the privateOfferId and the identity evidence is complete. Private offers add manual steps on the marketplace side — allow 24-48 hours after submission.

I'll create branch contoso-marketplace-fix and include a short README with validation commands.

Thanks,
Karthik
Principal Product Engineer
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Campbell <sarah.campbell@contoso.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>, Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 12:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Azure Marketplace publisher account: manifest/ARM template remediation + private-offer path

Sarah —

Appreciate the fast turn. Karthik and Vivek will push the PRs as they outlined. We'll message you in the PR for a quick validation run. Olga is compiling the evidence PDF and I'll follow-up with the signed MSA/DocuSign link as soon as legal completes.

Next steps: 
- Karthik: manifest PR (ETA ~40m) -> Contoso validates.
- Vivek: ARM + deploy-sample.sh PR (ETA ~90m) -> quick smoke deploy in Contoso test subscription.
- Olga: identity-evidence.pdf (ETA by EOD)
- Sarah: when legal signs the MSA, please post the DocuSign link and we'll attach for private-offer submission.

Meeting: Confirmed 1:00 PM PDT — 30 minute check-in. Agenda: verify portal acceptance and agree private-offer timeline.

Thanks all,
Marissa
Head, Marketplace Operations
Redwood Inference
